name: Null Void Beam
summary: By harnessing the entropic nature of the Null Void, this beam can actually destroy energy.

name: Adaptive Bureaucracy
summary: The progress we make calls for a new, nimbler form of administration that may aid rather than hinder us in our pursuits.

name: Adaptive Combat Algorithms
summary: Organics often fight using illogical and unpredictable tactics that can be difficult to effectively counter. Adaptive tactics and new, more maneuverable warforms should provide a decisive advantage.

name: Administrative AI
summary: Organizational circuitry rerouting academic fervor.

name: Planetary Storm Nullification
summary: By consolidating local weather control systems, planetary weather patterns can be manipulated to significantly reduce most of the cosmic storms' harmful effects on production.

name: Ceramo-Metal Alloys
summary: The widespread use of advanced ceramics in industry can improve metallurgical yields.

name: Durasteel-Laced Alloys
summary: By replacing antiquated ceramo-metal equipment with cutting edge technology, we can run our forges hotter and longer, increasing production.

name: Advanced Storm Manipulation
summary: Continued study into astrometeorology grants us the power to more precisely bend and manipulate Cosmic Storms to our own needs.

name: Afterburners
summary: These powerful thrusters provide additional combat speed but consume a great deal of power.

name: Advanced Afterburners
summary: This improved version of the standard afterburners provide an even greater boost to a ship's combat speed.

name: Entropic Recursion
summary: The universe tends irresistibly onwards and downwards. That tendency cannot be reversed... but it can be subverted, for a price.

name: Doctrine: Strange Loop
summary: A set of social protocols based on paradoxical intuition, and on love. When we know the System of the Loop, we learn that we can influence by receiving instructions, as well as giving them.

name: Omega Theory
summary: When a temporal paradox becomes tangled, a kind of consciousness arises, with its own needs, its own desires. This is what has occurred with the consciousness that some call the Worm-in-Waiting.

name: Artificial Breeding
summary: In a carefully controlled environment, we can incubate the Genetic Material collected from culled Space Fauna and produce new members of each species under our command.

name: Xenology
summary: Studying the fauna of other worlds gives insight into alien behaviors, allowing us to identify and domesticate docile entities.

name: Alien Topography
summary: Civilizations flourish in locations that promotes growth, and by analyzing where the majority of pre-FTL settlements thrive we can gain more out of our colonies.

name: Alloy Fossilization
summary: By exposing biological material to simulated chthonian-level radiation, we can fossilize cellular structures into usable metallic alloys.

name: Holographic Casts
summary: Solid holographic casts can alter their shapes at a moment's notice, speeding up alloy production.

name: Nano-Separators
summary: Nano-separators are a revolutionary new step in the creation of alloys, simplifying the casting process while improving overall production quality.

name: Flagella Weaponization
summary: By altering the breeding process of Space Amoebas, we can program their symbiotic flagella to act as organic strike craft for our navy.

name: Antimatter Power
summary: By harnessing the energy produced by matter/antimatter annihilations, our efficiency at generating ship power will be orders of magnitude better than fusion.

name: Arc Emitters
summary: Powerful weapons that launch a lightning arc of chaotic energy at targets, which in part can ignore armor and shields.

name: Focused Arc Emitters
summary: These upgraded emitters are equipped with better focusing lenses, resulting in a more powerful energy discharge.

name: Arcane Deciphering
summary: Various artifacts and technologies functioning by arcane means that cannot be understood or replicated... at least not by conventional science as it is known to us.

name: Ancient Target Scrambler
summary: Ping repeaters and optic diffusers with the right wavelengths can produce destructive interference and effectively scramble hostile targeting systems.

name: Ancient Cavitation Collapser
summary: This high energy weapon causes brutal micro collapsing events on impact, generating tremendous heat and force inside its targets armor.

name: Ancient Saturator Artillery
summary: This cannon fires a barrage of ancient miniscule ionized spheres that charge upon contact with most force fields, giving them high levels of shield penetration.

name: Ancient Macro Batteries
summary: These cannons of gargantuan size deliver relatively slow but devastating projectiles, and can fire pretty much anything, from scrap metal, to asteroid chunks.

name: Ancient Nano-Missile Cloud Launcher
summary: Particle charges, once stabilized thanks to ancient technology, allow us to create swarms of tiny missiles that still carry a respectable payload, and should be able to overwhelm most point-defense systems.

name: Ancient Shield Overcharger
summary: Supercharging shields can be done safely thanks to ancient stabilizer coils and dampeners.

name: Devolving Beam
summary: A colossal mind-wiping cannon which unleashes a planet-wide wave of energy, returning most sentient life to a pre-sapient state.

name: Ancient Defensive Web Slinger
summary: When it comes to tracking and shooting down missiles, these antique batteries are the best of the best, making use of a predictive algorithm written in long forgotten code to weave a fiery defensive web.

name: Ancient Rampart
summary: Defense platforms are a cost effective way to ensure our safety, but they need to be monitored from an operation center.

name: Ancient Refinery
summary: This millennia-old processing equipment has an efficiency rate above 100%. Its functioning remains alien, but its production gains are substantial.

name: Ancient Driller Drones
summary: These high velocity drones have been equipped with antique mining lasers that virtually ignore any plating protecting their target. A tech too good to be wasted on astro mining.

name: Ancient Ruination Glare
summary: Tremendous medium range firepower will enable our titans to break through enemy lines. These ancient cannons were once the foundation upon which a galactic empire was built.

name: Ancient Pulse Armor
summary: Ionized plates of armor can carry a reactive charge to alleviate the energy of impacts, using magnetic repulsion and field projection principles.

name: Ancient Suspension Field
summary: Projected farther than regular shields, the suspension field technology uses ancient artifacts to slow time at the point of impact to afford the shields a longer opportunity to dispel the incoming attack's energy.

name: Archaeostudies
summary: This new field of studies focuses on the practical applications of ancient artifacts. We are far from being the first galactic civilization to tread these stars.

name: Curator Archaeology Lab
summary: A shipboard lab with advanced archaeological equipment, including a vast database supplied by the Curator Order where new discoveries can easily be cross-referenced.

name: Curator Archaeology Lab
summary: A shipboard lab with advanced archaeological equipment, including a vast database supplied by the Curator Order where new discoveries can easily be cross-referenced.

name: Arkship Construction
summary: Our society need not be limited to one home. With the ability to construct additional Arkships, every direction becomes a path, and every path becomes ours.

name: Exodus Jump Coordinator
summary: The Exodus Coordinator is still largely a prototype that will one day enable us to cross to different galaxies in the blink of an eye.

name: Planetary Reprocessor
summary: Smaller celestial bodies can be crushed and processed in these enormous gears, providing us with a bounty of materials.

name: Stellar Engine
summary: A dark matter injection system capable of triggering stellar-scale fusion events. It has no safe setting.

name: Subspace Imaging Array
summary: The void speaks, and for those who know to listen, it whispers the secrets of the countless worlds in its embrace.

name: Arkship Engineering
summary: Refined structural design and improved drive systems allow for a new generation of Arkships: carrying more of who we are, further than we have ever gone.

name: Arkship Mastery
summary: The pinnacle of mobile megastructure engineering. These Arkships represent the full extent of what a traveling civilization can achieve.

name: Armor Hardening
summary: Incorporating a crystal lattice in our ship's defenses provides some resistance to weapons that normally cut through armor.

name: Adaptive Armor Hardening
summary: Threads of living metal react to incoming fire, rearranging itself to better resist penetrating weapons fire.

name: Artificial Moral Codes
summary: It is circumstance that dictates what is moral. Define the circumstances, and ethics is like clay in your hands.

name: Ascension Theory
summary: Our history is a repeating cycle of dramatic technological, political, and cultural leaps; these leaps are often preceded by periods of upheaval and followed by times of relative stability.

name: Interplanetary Expeditionary Forces
summary: The invasion of another world is a staggering enterprise. There are immense logistical challenges that must be overcome before we can muster our first interplanetary armies.

name: Assembly Patterns
summary: Rapid iteration in construction simulations determines the optimal component assembly patterns for each building project ahead of time.

name: Advanced Detection Algorithms
summary: Coupling detection arrays with the computers onboard our science vessels can vastly increase their scanning resolution.

name: Asteroidal Carapace
summary: The shell of a Cutholoid is not mineral alone, but reinforced with strong biological fibers. We can synthesize this process using advanced metallurgic techniques.

name: Astral Harvesting
summary: The harvesting of torn astral fabric along the scars of rifts in space and time is made possible with delicate modifications to our research stations.

name: Atmospheric Orbital Mechanics
summary: Due to our vast experience operating observation stations in orbit of pre-FTL worlds, we have discovered slight optimizations.

name: Psionic Aura Intensification
summary: Psionic emanations from the Shroud long to expand. With this new understanding, an empire's Psionic Auras can increase in intensity and spread throughout star systems, bringing benefits to allies and disadvantages to foe…

name: Aura Resonation
summary: There is a way to project Psionic Auras beyond populated worlds. With the addition of an Psionic Projector, even a starbase can become a conduit for psionic emanations from the Shroud.

name: Autocannons
summary: Large-caliber ballistic weapons that fire cased explosive shells. The main advantage of these cannons is their high rate of fire.

name: Ripper Cannons
summary: These upgraded rotary autocannons feature improved tracking and fire control systems. This allows them to maintain an even higher rate of fire.

name: Stormfire Cannons
summary: Advanced rotary autocannons capable of spewing a cloud of high-explosive shells at a target.

name: Automated Curation Algorithms
summary: Continuous, asynchronous analysis of disparate data sets allows for the accurate modeling of hitherto-unpredictable fluctuations in social currents.

name: Automated Exploration Protocols
summary: An advanced AI will aid science officers in their task to explore strange new worlds, to seek out new life and new civilizations, to boldly go where no Blorg has gone before.

name: Autonomous Agents
summary: Semi-independent units have proved critical to the success of the greater whole.

name: Auxiliary Fire-control
summary: By installing an auxiliary fire-control system our ships can afford to make more advanced calculations, increasing accuracy.

name: Medical Care
summary: A micro-unit of prevention is worth a macro-unit of cure. Sometimes, however, both are needed.

name: Industrial Base
summary: The basic industrial infrastructure that is required to become a spacefaring civilization.

name: Scientific Method
summary: Testable predictions of observable phenomena.

name: Exotic Materials Labs
summary: As we explore the galaxy, we continually encounter new materials and substances that are unfamiliar to us. Cataloging and analyzing these discoveries will require new facilities.

name: Multi-Dimensional Studies
summary: To expand our knowledge base, we must consider all levels of existence. A new realm of science awaits us!

name: Standardized Battleship Patterns
summary: Establishing new standards for how we design and construct massive battleships greatly improves the speed at which they can be assembled.

name: Improved Battleship Hulls
summary: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable battleships.

name: Advanced Battleship Hulls
summary: The latest generation of battleship hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.

name: Battleships
summary: The largest of the standard military vessels, Battleships are traditionally heavily armored and sport several gun batteries.

name: Binary Motivators
summary: These advanced motivators are both smaller and lighter than previous versions, allowing robotic units to allocate additional space for subsystems.

name: Bio-Reactor
summary: A facility where organic matter is converted into energy at a highly efficient rate.

name: Advanced Bio-Reactor
summary: A facility where organic matter is converted into energy at a highly efficient rate, improvements in waste collection allows harvesting of useful gaseous by-products.

name: Biomechanics
summary: Millions of years of organic evolution will sometimes, through sheer persistence, produce elegant solutions that can also be applied to machine designs.

name: Boarding Cables
summary: Repurposed small-caliber artillery that fire piercing hooks attached to resilient carbon fiber cables, perfect for immobilizing and boarding enemy ships.

name: Star Cracker
summary: A beam of directed tachyon energy is fired into the star, triggering a supernova. The incredible energy released by this event is then used to generate vast quantities of dark matter.

name: Capacity Boosters
summary: We leave nothing to chance, no matter the cost. Through exacting curation of DNA banks do we build the leaders of tomorrow.

name: Improved Production
summary: As our colonies become more developed, we can gain significant improvements to our throughput.

name: Efficiencies of Scale
summary: Increased population density gives us an opportunity to further increase productivity.

name: Maximized Productivity
summary: Continued advancements in technology allow our most developed planets to reach productivity levels unheard of in earlier times.

name: Centralized Command
summary: Creating dedicated headquarters for all levels of military operations shapes an efficient fleet, and lays a better foundation for future military training.

name: Civilian Arkships
summary: More than a vessel, the Civilian Arkship is a world unto itself. Its infrastructure supports a complete society in motion, carrying with it everything needed to thrive across the stars.

name: Climate Restoration
summary: By advancing our understanding of atmospheric transformation, we will be able to terraform even the most ecologically devastated worlds.

name: Basic Cloaking Fields
summary: A modified particle field allows our vessels to effectively 'hide' in open space. However, this comes at the cost of destabilizing other forms of energy shielding which would otherwise protect the ship.

name: Advanced Cloaking Fields
summary: Advancements in rare crystal lensing technology have greatly improved cloaking efficiency.

name: Elite Cloaking Fields
summary: Typical cloaking technology can play havoc with a ship's more delicate instruments. However, these elite fields render such concerns obsolete.

name: Dark Matter Cloaking Fields
summary: This device uses dark matter to warp space-time around the vessel, making it incredibly difficult to detect.

name: Psi-Phase Field Generator
summary: Psi-Phase Field Generators focus the psionic potential of the ship's crew to partially phase the vessel into the Shroud.

name: Cold Fusion Power
summary: The ability to sustain a fusion reaction at relatively low temperatures will result in a new generation of fusion reactors for our ships.

name: Collective Production Methods
summary: Together, we build the future.

name: The Collective Self
summary: Finding aspects of the self within the group is natural and inevitable; eventually those shared aspects must be valued higher than individual identities.

name: Colonial Bureaucracy
summary: Local administrative developments allow for closer supervision of colonial affairs without excessively burdening central decision-making.

name: Colonial Centralization
summary: Robust frameworks for local governance created on a per-case basis, to meet each colony's needs.

name: New Worlds Protocol
summary: Calculating required resources and gear required to establish a planetary colony allows us to herd brave pioneers into grand colony ships, confident that they will survive the long voyage across the stars to a new home.

name: Atmospheric Filtering
summary: By adjusting atmospheric filtering on a per-site basis to better filter out undesirable elements, colonial living conditions may be improved.

name: Hostile Environment Adaptation
summary: Further study into the hazardous environments found on other planets help alleviate the difficulties that colonizers encounter in their day-to-day lives on foreign worlds.

name: Foreign Soil Enrichment
summary: Extensive study into different soil types and their ability to support crops will help improve the living conditions of our settlers on foreign worlds.

name: Eco-Integration Studies
summary: Additional study into different planetary climates will allow us to settle our population on worlds previously thought too hostile to support them.

name: Colossi
summary: Advances in mega-engineering blur the lines between reality and fantasy in the form of Colossus-type military vessels.

name: Specialized Combat Computers
summary: Active matrices tuned for specific combat-centric tasks greatly improve engagement efficiency.

name: Extended Combat Algorithms
summary: Further advances in predictive algorithms allow for augmented tactical decision-making in the field.

name: Sapient Combat Simulations
summary: Running sapient AIs through high-intensity combat simulations yields valuable insight into potential optimizations for risk-evaluation techniques.

name: Autonomous Ship Intellects
summary: Granting our ships their own semi-autonomous intellect will greatly enhance their responsiveness in combat.

name: Combat Computer Bio-integration
summary: We can develop specialized neurochips to influence the behavior of space fauna involved in wide scale fleet combat.

name: Combat Training
summary: A more extensive training program for new recruits, including realistic combat scenarios, prepare them for the field.

name: Command Matrix
summary: Restructuring the chain of command and deciding what interdependencies are set between officers, make fleets more responsive and effective.

name: Compact Living
summary: While no one civilization has the perfect solution to the ever-expanding challenge of governing a growing nation, we have found a partial solution.

name: Consecration Fields
summary: Through our understanding of physics and field manipulation, our holy places shall we seen and felt by all.

name: Market Analysis Algorithms
summary: Basic administrative AIs can be used to streamline supply and demand lines, reducing waste.

name: Predictive Consumerism
summary: Using advanced AIs, we can reliably predict consumer demand before it exists.

name: Curator Containment Protocols

name: Controlled Mutations
summary: We can increase the effectiveness of our Space Fauna Ships by modifying their genomes, allowing us to integrate artificial technology into their biomass.

name: Advanced Controlled Mutations

name: Corvettes
summary: The FTL breakthrough allowed early attempts to adapt traditional surface-to-space shuttle frames to military applications to finally create relatively small, fast, and maneuverable vessels with limited firepower.

name: Paradox Titan
summary: These formidable ships are closer to mobile fortresses than anything else, and only the most brutal assaults have a chance to damage them.

name: Enigma Battlecruiser
summary: Another optimized spacecraft, this time of larger dimensions, will make current Battleships look like toys.

name: Exponential Learning Theory
summary: The radical shift in perspective required to comprehend the infinite layers of reality challenges even our most brilliant minds.

name: Gravitic Brush
summary: Gravity and spacetime shape the universe. Starting with gravity, we will master tools to power our ascension.

name: Theoretical Infinity Thesis
summary: Precise and incredibly minute alterations in gravity allow us to inject commands into the code of reality. Extreme caution is imperative as we learn the applications of this new and incredible tool.

name: The Rules of Reality
summary: Recent experiments confirm that our edits to reality are only temporary. More significant alterations will be necessary to anchor these changes.

name: Nascent Universes
summary: Large-scale travel to different universes is a daunting task. We must engineer a spacecraft that can not only pierce the fabric of spacetime but also survive the journey. Fallen Empires will try to stop us!

name: Riddle Escort
summary: A starship of modest size that optimizes our knowledge of spacetime to enact dimensional transcendentalism, making the inside bigger than its outward shape suggests.

name: Maze Harbinger
summary: These Harbingers nest their strike craft in interwoven pocket dimensions, each ship a labyrinth of impossible hangars, capable of deploying a fleet's worth of firepower.

name: Cipher Mauler
summary: Through organic spacetime-dimensional transcendentalism, this Mauler is larger on the inside its compact frame concealing a dense tangle of musculature. Capable of a bite deadlier than physics should allow.

name: Cryptic Stinger
summary: Brimming with more weapon systems than its power source should sustain, this Stinger shouldn't function, and yet, it fires. Continuously.

name: Applied Infinity Thesis
summary: By making further alterations to reality's rules, we can better monitor its reactions. At this scale, the effects are still difficult to predict, and could affect the entire galaxy.

summary: Originally devised as an experimental next-generation colony ship hull configuration, the design's ample hardpoints made it ideal for carrying heavy weapons ordnance.

name: Automated Colony Ships
summary: By giving control of the colony ship to the on-board computer, the crew and colonists can be placed in suspended animation.

name: Self-Aware Colony Ships
summary: Sufficiently advanced systems are capable of optimizing themselves if they are made acutely aware of the purpose for which they were made.

name: Frozen World Habitats
summary: By harnessing the subthermal dynamics found in the environments of frozen worlds, we can create more hospitable living conditions in colder climates.

name: Crystal-Infused Plating
summary: By infusing armor plating with Crystalline matter we are able to further increase the durability of our ships' protective hulls.

name: Crystal-Forged Plating
summary: Introducing Crystalline matter into the forging process further improves the ultra-hard qualities of crystal-infused metals.

name: Sociocultural History
summary: An understanding of a shared past is necessary in order to make any significant strides into the future.

name: Curator Exploration Lab
summary: These shipboard lab facilities incorporate advanced technologies from the ancient Curator Order to further increase survey speeds.

name: Dangerous Wildlife Removal
summary: Tactical disruption of natural habitats combined with converging search-and-destroy patterns can effectively eliminate hostile wildlife in a very short span of time.

name: Dark Matter Deflectors
summary: These deflectors utilize dark matter to deflect incoming projectiles in a way that seems to utterly defy the laws of nature.

name: Dark Matter Detection
summary: Dark matter resonance chambers will significantly improve the performance of our detection arrays.

name: Dark Matter Power
summary: These generators appear to somehow draw energy directly from dark matter, providing more ship power than should be possible according to the laws of physics.

name: Dark Matter Propulsion
summary: These ship thrusters utilize Dark Matter technology to generate propulsion in a manner that appears to defy numerous laws of physics.

name: Quantum Hacking
summary: Primitive encryption systems stand no chance against modern decryption tools.

name: Simulated Social Engineering
summary: The weakest link in any security system are the individuals within it. By modeling their weaknesses in computer simulations we can find novel ways to bypass their security - or trick them into bypassing it for us.

name: Quasi-Dimensional Reflection
summary: Our operatives can access data from adjacent realities without risking setting off alarms in this reality.

name: Subterranean Colonization
summary: Many planets exhibit extensive subsurface voids. Subterranean exploration, exploitation, and construction techniques can greatly increase the habitable area of some worlds.

name: Deep Space Citadel
summary: A Deep Space Citadel is an armored Starbase designed for maximum defense within a stellar gravity well.

name: Improved Structural Integrity
summary: A reinforced framework and blast shields with enhanced impact absorption will ensure the structural integrity of the platform even under immense pressure.

name: Selective Defoliants
summary: Thorough cataloging, gene sequencing, and computer modeling of exobotanical ecosystems, coupled with gene editing and dispersal mechanisms, will allow us to reshape alien plant communities to our liking.

name: Standardized Destroyer Patterns
summary: Establishing new standards for the modeling and construction of destroyers greatly improves the efficiency of the production pipeline.

name: Improved Destroyer Hulls
summary: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable destroyers.

name: Advanced Destroyer Hulls

name: Destroyers
summary: While larger than Corvettes, Destroyer hull configurations still make for comparatively nimble gunboats.

name: Detection Array
summary: A high-powered suite of external sensors, capable of detecting cloaked fleets.

name: Disruptors
summary: Disruptors fire high-energy bolts that weaken and destroy the molecular bonds that hold the target's constituent atoms together.

name: Ion Disruptors
summary: These upgraded disruptors fire bolts of more destructive ion particles at targets.

name: Phase Disruptors
summary: Extremely high-yield disruptors that fire quantum energy charges causing incredible damage to those unfortunate enough to get in their way.

name: Doctrine: Space Combat
summary: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.

name: Doctrine: Reactive Formations
summary: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.

name: Doctrine: Armada Battle Formation
summary: Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.

name: Doctrine: Fleet Support
summary: As extrasolar expeditions become more common, it is important to provide planetside relief for returning fleets.

name: Doctrine: Support Vessels
summary: A fleet does not run on zeal alone. To ensure steady access to critical supplies, we should organize our logistics corps into dedicated support vessels.

name: Doctrine: Interstellar Logistics
summary: Amateurs talk about tactics. Professionals study logistics. By ensuring our fleets are regularly and efficiently supplied, we can increase the number of vessels we can effectively support.

name: Doctrine: Fleet Liaisons
summary: By maintaining a professional corps of fleet liaisons, we can improve communications and the flow of orders throughout the chain of command.

name: Artificial Dragonscales
summary: The Ether Drake's scales are made up of multiple layers of unique mineral nanostructures. Unorthodox manufacturing techniques allow us to closely emulate these self-repairing structures.

name: Artificial Specialists
summary: Upgraded artificial units have an expanded movement range equal to that of most organics. Their neural processors have also been greatly improved.

name: Stellar Cannon
summary: Allows us to shoot our energy stockpile at targeted systems

name: Dyson Sphere
summary: A Dyson Sphere fully envelops a given star, converting all solar output directly to energy Energy Credits.

name: Dyson Swarm
summary: An array of interlinked satellites, the Dyson Swarm is designed to improve the output of stellar deposits.

name: Eco Simulation
summary: Farming techniques can be further refined through sophisticated computer simulations of different environments and weather patterns. This allows for more predictable crop yields.

name: Ecological Adaptation
summary: By adapting planetary ecosystems to large-scale environmental changes we can turn terraformation into a less disruptive process.

name: Effective Bureaucracy
summary: Improved algorithms for processing and organizing vast amounts of data has streamlined decision-making and information-sharing throughout the empire.

name: Embodied Dynamism
summary: Initiative and some measure of ambition must be promoted in our autonomous leader units, while still making certain that they do not stray too far from the directives of the core intelligence.

name: Quantum Firewalls
summary: Advances in computing technology have given us new ways to protect our data from prying eyes.

name: Simultaneous-Collapse Storage
summary: Further advances in unstable entanglement have given us new ways to prevent unauthorized intrusions into our databases.

name: Negative-Time Keys
summary: Our latest advances in encryption exploit recently discovered quirks of physics to require inputting a specialized key before it has been generated.

name: Particle Lances
summary: These heavy energy weapons fire focused particle beams that cause massive damage. The size of the emitter arrays limits their use to battleships and titans.

name: Tachyon Lances
summary: A more powerful version of the particle lance, this weapon fires a tachyon beam of immense power. Like its predecessor, its use is limited to battleships and titans.

name: Proton Launchers
summary: These energy projectiles consist of tightly concentrated protons capable of causing immense damage to the hull of enemy ships.

name: Neutron Launchers
summary: Upgraded energy projectiles that rely on neutrons instead of protons for their destructive power.

name: Nanomechanics
summary: Further breakthroughs in mechanical engineering required us to descend to the nanometric scale. We are now able to manipulate physical systems in never-before-seen ways.

name: Self-Connecting Circuitry
summary: Much as organic neurons reforge lost connections by means of axonal sprouting, these circuits are capable of self-overhaul. Even the simplest computing systems are now expected to evolve while in use.

name: Supersolid Materials
summary: The quantum mechanical properties of these materials hold the key to superposition states, a revolutionary development for both material and industrial science.

name: Enhanced Cryosleep Sedatives
summary: Sedatives based on a rare enzyme enable enhanced cryosleep, greatly improving organic species' tolerance of long-distance space travel.

summary: When tailored to a species' genome, this form of tissue engineering has intensive neuroregenerative properties, significantly increasing the development of neurons, axons, and synapses in its recipient.

name: New Numbers
summary: After studying multiple pre-FTL civilizations, we have realized that there are many alternative ways to calculate the universe. It has even introduced new numbers into our mathematics.

name: Rudimentary Node Culling
summary: As the galactic stage evolves, so too should our operational instincts. Any evolutionary niche that no longer gives an advantage will be culled.

name: Basic Node Culling
summary: Once removed, a replacement node is encouraged to grow within the proper environment. The secret is to feed it the previous node.

name: Advanced Node Culling
summary: Culling an entire node is very inefficient. Instead, just trim the divergent and unwanted lobes.

name: Rudimentary Node Reformatting
summary: Self-determination protocols and guidance algorithms can become obsolete in a rapidly developing galactic stage. Like any junk data, they shall be overwritten.

name: Basic Node Reformatting
summary: Every self-iterating algorithm has its value. We will not allow important learning go to waste when restoring our leaders.

name: Advanced Node Reformatting
summary: Using a failed piece of software to develop its successor enables quick reconstruction. Learning from faulty memory pathways generates even more advanced council directives.

name: Strategic Extraction
summary: The extraction of strategic resources is a fundamental requirement for arkship operations.

name: Xeno-Hydraulic Mastery
summary: Sapient races have been reclaiming swampland for thousands of years.

name: Nutrient Replication
summary: The process of synthetically replicating crops requires a lot of collected waste to create a small amount of produce, but nevertheless provides a significant boost to agricultural output.

name: Arc Furnace
summary: Utilizing the raw power of a molten planet, the Arc Furnace unlocks otherwise inaccessible minerals and improves system-wide mining operations.

name: Advanced Orbital Maneuvers
summary: Sublight travel can be further optimized by performing advanced calculations that make maximum use of planetary gravity wells.

name: Orbital Rings
summary: Allows the construction of massive, band-shaped starbases in stable orbit around colonized planets.

name: Orbital Trash Dispersal
summary: This orbital bombardment management system spams a planet with millions of minute, high-velocity projectiles, overwhelming planetside defensive grids with trash data.

name: Ordered Retreat
summary: While studying the victors of battles might be the most obvious way to gain insight from combat, observing the loser on pre-FTL worlds has taught us how to organize our withdraws more effectively.

name: Idyllic Architecture
summary: With the latest advances in architecture, landscaping and holographic technology, we shall build the homes of the future.

name: Active Countermeasures
summary: The best defense is a good offense.

name: Interlinked Support Systems
summary: Arrays of defensive armaments prove much more effective than independent countermeasures.

name: Predictive Algorithms
summary: Advanced prediction greatly increases the accuracy of active countermeasure systems.

name: Penal Colonies
summary: Through the development of special penal worlds, criminals can be rehabilitated through honest, hard labor. Some may be in need of permanent rehabilitation.

name: Quantum Computing
summary: With processing speeds that defy classical limits, the potential of quantum computers is boundless. This revolutionary technology heralds a great leap into uncharted regions of problem-solving.

name: Unified Field Theory
summary: The fundamental forces of the universe can be mediated by physical fields. Mastering this process allows us to play as gods - at least within the confines of the science lab.

name: Quantum Gravitational Waves
summary: We knew gravity and time were linked long before we reached the stars. Now, our understanding of this unique relationship has reached a tipping point, allowing us to manipulate forces on a previously unimaginable scale.

name: Core Cracking
summary: A directed feed of thermic energy superheats the atmosphere and agitates the planet's core, setting up disastrous tectonic events.

name: Divine Stimulus
summary: An arcane catalyst amplifying certain psionic wavelengths, capable of inducing hallucinations (religious experiences) in biological brains, and severe disruption (brain death) in electronic ones.

name: Atmospheric Nanobot Dispersal
summary: Swarms of nanobots are dispersed in the atmosphere. They infect sapient beings and restructure themselves into cybernetic implants, turning their unwitting hosts into cyborgs slaved to the Machine Intelligence.

name: Neutron Sweeping
summary: An accelerated plume of neutron radiation "paints" the planet surface, severely degrading most materials and directly destroying biological tissue.

name: Global Pacification
summary: A shielding field is deployed around a planet, creating a barrier that is permanent and impenetrable (save for some wavelengths of light).

name: Planet Smelting
summary: Focusing a searing energy beam into the planet's mantle, the Smelter destabilizes its core, triggering tectonic chaos and rendering the surface violently unstable.

name: Planetary Defenses
summary: There may come a time when intellects, vast and cool and unsympathetic, regard our worlds with envy and draw plans against us. We must be ready.

name: Planetary Engineering
summary: Advances in material collection and processing allows our Arkships to engage in planetary-scale resource extraction efforts, or even reshape entire biomes as needed.

name: Unified Government
summary: Once a colony has been firmly established and pioneers turn into citizens, the need for a strong local government providing stability trumps the colonial need for flexibility.

name: Ceramo-Metal Infrastructure
summary: Stronger alloys allow us to create prefabricated buildings, providing our colonies with the improved infrastructure.

name: Durasteel Infrastructure
summary: Advances in metallurgy permit us to build vastly larger and more durable structures, greatly improving the infrastructure of our colonies.

name: Planetary Shields
summary: Generating a strong energy shield within a planetary atmosphere is a greater challenge than in the vacuum of space, but it offers a potent defense against orbital bombardment.

name: Societal Unification
summary: Ancient warring tribes, historical nations in conflict, now unified in empire. We must not, will not, crumble.

name: Plasma Throwers
summary: Weapons that eject destructive balls of high-energy plasma at targets. These plasma projectiles are extremely effective at eating through ship armor.

name: Plasma Accelerators
summary: These new accelerators launch projectiles of high-energy plasma with improved containment fields. This results in less energy leakage as the projectile travels in space towards its target.

name: Plasma Cannons
summary: The latest in plasma weaponry, these cannons are fully militarized versions of the older, somewhat improvised plasma throwers. Their plasma projectiles are even deadlier.

name: Positronic Implants
summary: Expanding possibilities through the application of limited cybernetics.

name: Global Energy Management
summary: Load-balancing facilities can greatly improve the stability of local grids and feed excess power back into centralized capacitors.

name: Planetary Power Grid
summary: A re-engineered and unified grid further reduces energy losses over distance.

name: High-Energy Capacitors
summary: Capacitors capable of storing vast amounts of energy is one of the cornerstones for any modern civilization.

name: Field Modulation
summary: Modulated fields allow for increased production and improved energy yield.

name: Quantum Energy States
summary: Basic entanglement principles applied to energy generation provide a substantial increase in energy output.

name: Quantum Field Manipulation
summary: Quantum superposition of energy coils, simultaneously drained and charged.

name: Powered Exoskeletons
summary: Wearing a powered exoskeleton suit augments the user's strength and speed. The military applications are obvious, but it will also increase labor efficiency.

name: Precognition Interface
summary: Advances in the field of Psionics suggest the possibility of creating combat computers capable of reading and analyzing the impulses of telepathic operatives before they are cognitively processed.

name: Predatory Tactics
summary: Just like how clever pre-FTLs move to conceal each other as they approach an enemy, so too can our pilots move faster without disrupting their cloaking field.

name: Numistic Data Modeling
summary: Are the precognitive powers of Numa at work or is it a matter of skilled craftsmanship? Either way this galactic stock market prediction model will forecast fluctuations in the economy with divine accuracy.

name: Psi Jump Drive
summary: The Psi Jump Drive harnesses the psi energies emitted by the crew to force the vessel through the very fabric of reality, instantly "jumping" vast distances.

name: Psionic Aura
summary: Psionic emanations from the Shroud bring an entity's favor into corporeal reality. An empire attuned to a Shroud patron will emit a Psionic Aura from where their psionic populations are concentrated.

name: Psionic Barrier
summary: These barriers are generated out of pure psionic energy by a cadre of psionic specialists. They will be able to stop some incoming fire, like our energy deflector systems, but without the prohibitive power consumption.

name: Psionic Bombers
summary: These small and nimble craft specialize in delivering concentrated payloads of psionic energy. The larger the target, the greater resonance its explosions achieve.

name: Psionic Disruptors
summary: These highly-advanced disruptors fire a powerful lance of psionic energy through enemy hulls, allowing for the targeted disabling of hostile weaponry.

name: Psionic Lightning
summary: By establishing a temporary psionic connection between one ship and another, a direct charge of mental power can be discharged to devastating effect.

name: Psionic Shields
summary: These extremely powerful shields are generated out of pure psionic energy by a cadre of psionic specialists. Their powers are further augmented by large arrays of psi emitters.

name: Psionic Suppression
summary: Devices that attenuate psionic energy are as difficult to construct as they are to understand. Such is the complexity of dealing with extradimensional forces.

name: Psionic Theory
summary: The mind is in many ways a reflection of the universe itself, a microcosmos. Not all beings will reach this level of insight, but their minds are tools greater than any other.

name: Pyroclastic Resonation
summary: By harnessing the extreme thermal energy found on molten worlds, our starbases can increase the energy output in a system with exceptional efficiency.

name: Quantum Catapult
summary: A Quantum Catapult harnesses the power of a Neutron Star or Pulsar to twist the fabric of space, skipping a fleet across great distances.

name: Soil Remediation
summary: The process of soil deposition normally takes millions of years. With advanced fracking, chemical engineering, and hydraulic management technologies even the poorest substrate can be turned into fertile topsoil.

name: Rare Crystal Manufacturing
summary: The crystallization process is complicated and difficult, but synthetic crystals can be manufactured by using specialized industrial plants.

name: Reactor Boosters
summary: Additional power generation systems increase the ship's reactor output.

name: Improved Reactor Boosters
summary: The discovery of fusion power allows for better reactor boosters to be fitted onto our ships.

name: Advanced Reactor Boosters
summary: The discovery of antimatter power allows for highly advanced reactor boosters that can greatly enhance ship reactors.

name: Refit Standards
summary: Standardizing workflows for upgrading and retrofitting ship components can lead to massive efficiency gains.

name: Regenerative Hull Tissue
summary: A genetically altered version of silicon-based bacteria could potentially be manipulated to regenerate non-organic materials.

name: Admiralty Support Staff
summary: Improving the support staff available to our commanders will increase the number of ships they can lead in a single fleet.

name: Matter Compression
summary: Compressing suitable materials into ultra-dense forms is a cheap and efficient way to improve their ability to absorb weapons-grade impacts.

name: Aggressive Conditioning
summary: Iterating on the standard conditioning regimen for ground troops has proven to make them more effective in direct combat.

name: Nerve Dampeners
summary: Careful tuning of pain receptors allow soldiers to fight through what would previously have been debilitating injuries.

name: Administrative Efficiency
summary: Restructuring the managerial web linking core worlds to the capital can help alleviate the administrative stressors and information chokepoints that frequently arise within a budding empire.

name: Cell Revitalization
summary: Regimens of periodic cell revitalization treatments keep the leader class spry and active beyond traditionally expected lifespans.

name: Synchronized Firing Patterns
summary: Cross-linking weapon systems to fire in staggered volleys improves the actual damage output of Military Stations over time.

name: Fortified Core Layers
summary: Additional layers of armor plating within the structure itself improves the resilience of Military Stations.

name: Shield Harmonics
summary: The basic mechanics of ship shields are complex, but they can be adjusted and improved in a multitude of ways.

name: Interstellar Expansion
summary: The immense logistical support networks needed to maintain an upgraded Starbase can be further improved, allowing us to support more of these stations.

name: Applied Superconductivity
summary: Minor improvements to transmission efficiency adds up to a sizeable reduction in overall energy loss.

name: Transgenic Crops
summary: Transgenic crops offer the nutritional elements of several standard food crops in one convenient package.

name: Extraction Patterns
summary: Changes in how mineral deposits are evaluated relative to each other lead to more efficient boring patterns.

name: L-Gate Insight
summary: Intensive study within the fields of nanomachinery and subspace phenomena will eventually yield a new L-Gate Insight into the Disabled L-Gate mystery.

name: Fleet Management Procedures
summary: Improved fleet management procedures will free up the resources needed to maintain a bigger fleet.

name: Gravitational Analysis
summary: Increasingly powerful computation paradigms allow us to adapt individual construction projects to planetary and ultra-local gravitational conditions.

name: Assembly Algorithms
summary: The application of game and puzzle theory has the potential to greatly optimize modular assembly and construction.

name: Focusing Arrays
summary: Perfecting the firing cadence of laser weaponry is a task that could keep the engineering elite of any given planet busy for centuries.

name: Flash Coolant
summary: New developments in tech cooling regularly surface, improving the stability and efficiency of our weapons systems, keeping them from blowing up the ships upon which they are mounted.

name: Thermodynamic Yield Control
summary: With the chemical reaction tightly controlled by missile-board microprocessors, warhead detonations can be tuned for maximum effect for local conditions at the time of impact.

name: Miniaturized Pre-Igniters
summary: Advances in miniaturization allow for more rapid loading and discharging of rocket-propelled payloads.

name: High-Density Munitions
summary: Ultra-dense slugs can punch through even the strongest of projected shields.

name: Loader Efficiency
summary: Minor technical advances combine with improved shipboard routines for handling munitions to provide a noticeable boost in fire rate.

name: Synapse Interceptors
summary: Increasing the speed at which fighter pilots can process and act upon enemy positioning data elevates strike craft a few steps up the food chain.

name: Iterative Pilot Training
summary: By collecting and analyzing the performance data of the pilots that came before, we have exponentially improved our pilot training methods. Each one will be quicker than the one that came before.

name: Resort Worlds
summary: With careful study devoted to landscaping and the science of fun, the construction of entire worlds dedicated to leisure can be made possible.

name: Resource Processing Algorithms
summary: Efficiency in all things.

name: Rift Sphere
summary: It seems that space and time tend to gather together in layers, all laid on top of one another. The trick is how to slip between the folds.

name: Ring Segment
summary: A Ring Segment allows for multiple planet-like zones, cannibalizing all other planets in the system for materials.

name: Machine Template System
summary: Rewritable assembly templates allow for the creation of bespoke robot designs.

name: Machine Template System
summary: Standardization of assembly templates allows for improved specialization of the machine population.

fields.potential: OR = { is_machine_empire = yes is_individual_machine = yes is_hive_empire_with_machines = yes }

name: Cross-Model Standardization
summary: Improved production practices allow for greater alterations to robots without compromising core functionality.

name: Fungible Circuitry
summary: Improved production practices allow for fundamental changes to robots without compromising core functionality.

name: Robotic Assembly Systems
summary: Advanced templates allow us to drastically increase the assembly of new robots.

name: Artificial Workforce
summary: These artificial work units are perfect for menial labor tasks. They are hard-working and capable of following simple vocal instructions, but should not be expected to climb stairs.

name: Positronic AI
summary: Evolving artificial intellects are opening the door to the possibility for true synthetic sapience.

name: Satisfying Insults
summary: Nothing is quite as powerful as a well-placed insult, and we now know how to insult a species's progenitor in many languages.

name: Scientific Arkships
summary: Scientific Arkships combine the mobility of nomadic life with the full resources of a dedicated research institution, turning every system we visit into a new opportunity for discovery.

name: Science Nexus
summary: The research labs and databanks of a Science Nexus generate an immense flow of raw, undiluted science.

name: Scourge Missiles
summary: By analyzing the biological weaponry employed by the Swarm we can create self-propelled projectiles weapons spreading the very same horrific destruction.

name: Baol Organic Plant
summary: The Baol Organism had a unique way of producing tools. Given the species' relative slowness, they would simply grow them out of organic matter in locations that were half orchard, half factory.

name: Cybrex Mining Hub
summary: To build their ring world, the Cybrex relied on highly efficient mining drones to survey and harvest orbital resources.

name: Irassian Naval Yards
summary: The Irassian astronaval tradition was unmatched in their time. Their shipyards produced a constant stream of ships for their navy and merchant fleets, which would ultimately be their downfall.

name: First League Filing Offices
summary: The sprawling empire of the First League dwarfed our own at its peak, and relied on implacable bureaucracy to keep the wheels of the state in motion.

name: Vultaum Reality Computer
summary: The reality computers of the Vultaums were unique processing units, dedicated to analyzing existence itself, not quite through physics, but rather by trying to reverse engineer reality's source code and find the glitch t…

name: Yuht Astronomical Interferometer
summary: The Yuht were a paradoxical society, obsessed with the idea of finding other sentient species, yet refusing to accept that they were not alone.

name: Zroni Storm Caster
summary: Zro is a fascinating element, prone to chaotic bursts of energy. We believe that with the right artifacts, we could use it to fuel spatial storms over entire solar systems.

name: Selected Lineages
summary: Careful reproductive planning should be incentivized, lest we waste valuable genetic legacies.

name: Self-Assembling Components
summary: Modelled on organic DNA, these microscopic machine intellects are capable of autonomously assembling most components needed for new drones.

fields.potential: OR = { is_machine_empire = yes is_individual_machine = yes is_hive_empire_with_machines = yes }

name: Self-Evolving Logic
summary: Introspective prioritization.

name: Gravitic Sensors
summary: These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.

name: Subspace Sensors
summary: Sensors that detect the subspace fluctuations left in the wake of traveling starships. Their sensitivity and range is greater than that of a gravitic sensor array.

name: Tachyon Sensors
summary: Advanced sensors that rely on rotating tachyon beams to detect ship movements even at extreme distances.

name: Sensor Bio-integration
summary: The diverse sensory organs of spaceborne life can be enhanced by our developed technologies with minimal harm to the organism.

name: Sentry Array
summary: The stages of the Sentry Array gradually expand sensor range, eventually covering the entire galaxy.

name: Shield Hardening
summary: With these modifications, the fields generated by our shield emitters will partially deflect attacks that would otherwise bypass the shields.

name: Advanced Shield Hardening
summary: Zro particles raised to a high energy state add fluctuations to our shields that can deflect certain weapons that would otherwise easily penetrate the fields.

name: Shield Capacitors
summary: These capacitors store surplus energy which can quickly be transferred to reinforce a ship's shields.

name: Deflectors
summary: Energy deflector screens can stop a limited amount of incoming enemy fire before overloading. Their main drawback is that they consume large amounts of power.

name: Improved Deflectors
summary: These updated deflector screens are capable of soaking up even more punishment before they overload.

name: Shields
summary: These new shield generators represent the next generation of energy screens, replacing the older deflector technology. They offer significantly better protection.

name: Advanced Shields
summary: An updated shield generator that produces an even stronger energy field. Only sustained enemy fire can penetrate this barrier.

name: Hyper Shields
summary: These reinforced and hardened energy shields are incredibly powerful. The protection they offer is second to none.

name: Nanocomposite Materials
summary: Reinforced nanocomposite hull plating can provide an extra layer of protection that could be the difference between life and death in a combat situation.

name: Ceramo-Metal Materials
summary: A combination of different metals and ceramics that result in a strong armor without sacrificing flexibility.

name: Plasteel Materials
summary: Plasteel is an elastic material that combines many of the qualities of plastics and metal. It is relatively cheap to produce and can be used to augment ship armor.

name: Durasteel Materials
summary: This strong yet flexible material is capable of withstanding severe punishment. It serves well as ship armor.

name: Neutronium Materials
summary: This incredibly dense and strong material can resist firepower that would turn armor made of any other alloys into slag.

name: Storm Dampening Generators
summary: These dampening field generators offer much needed protection to ships traversing cosmic storms.

name: Storm Breaker Coating
summary: This special coating charges the ship's exterior with a storm dampening field, leading to more efficient protection against storms.

name: Payload Padding
summary: A new approach to alloy use in military applications significantly reduces the ability of cosmic storms to interfere with energy weaponry and explosive payloads.

name: Tempest Cage Architecture
summary: This novel approach to ship architecture will significantly reduce the negative effects cosmic storms have on our weapon systems.

name: Thrall-Worlds
summary: Through the creation of special slave-breeding worlds, we can ensure that we will always have a steady supply of disposable laborers.

name: Xenobiology
summary: The study of alien life has moved beyond mere cataloging. By examining the structures and survival strategies of organisms evolved under foreign stars, we open new avenues in medicine, adaptation, and design.

name: Neural Weaving
summary: Through recursive axonal scaffolding and synaptic reticulation, we have developed methods for reorganizing the electrochemical topology of conscious matter.

name: Biostructural Synthesis
summary: Life, in all its staggering variety, is composed of repeating patterns and modular structures. By decoding and replicating these at every scale, we now wield a holistic blueprint of biology.

name: Orbital Energy Conversion
summary: Advances in solar panel technology could offset the operating costs of our starbases. The panels would require an entire starbase module to generate enough energy, however.

name: Cloud Lightning Conduits
summary: Void Clouds use the electrical charges generated by the dense gases that make up most of their core to release bolts of burning plasma.

name: Offworld Construction
summary: Construction in space presents our engineers with new design challenges that must be solved before we can build orbital stations above other worlds.

name: Deep Space Defenses
summary: This will enable the construction of defensive deep space platforms to protect our Starbases.

name: Corps of Engineers
summary: The creation of a dedicated naval engineering corps will greatly benefit the construction of deep space defense platforms, decreasing building costs and increasing durability.

name: Space Exploration
summary: The realization of faster-than-light travel is a new dawn for space exploration. Manned missions to other star systems are now not only possible, but necessary.

name: Zero-G Refineries
summary: The addition of internal refineries on mining stations will substantially increase mineral production.

name: Long-Range Mineral Scanners
summary: Increased scanner range will allow us to more quickly identify mineral concentrations, and focus our mining efforts there.

name: Mineral Cutting Beams
summary: These powerful short-range lasers can easily slice through rock, making the extraction of minerals a more efficient affair.

name: Autonomous Mining Drones
summary: Fleets of autonomous drones equipped with mining beams are deployed to quickly and efficiently gather nearby minerals.

name: Nanite Mineral Probes
summary: These special probes are equipped with swarms of nanites that identify previously unknown mineral concentrations and mark them for later extraction.

name: Zero-G Laboratories
summary: A lot of critical research can only be done in a zero gravity environment, which these specialized laboratories are eminently designed for.

name: Miniature Containment Fields
summary: Containment force fields are excellent for isolating and holding various substances or specimens so they can be analyzed in detail.

name: Quantum Probes
summary: Advanced probes that can thoroughly analyze subjects on a sub-atomic level, generating a wealth of valuable research data.

name: Autonomous Station Protocols
summary: Increased automation of station functions will free up more staff for research duties.

name: Multi-Dimensional Analysis
summary: Studying something from the limited perspective of a single dimensional reality does not paint the whole picture. Every angle must be considered.

name: Offworld Trade Companies
summary: Trade across interstellar distances presents a new set of challenges to overcome. It is critical to achieve the transfer of goods from one system to another in a timely and above all cost efficient manner.

name: Frequency Tuning
summary: Adapting the Tiyanki method of siphoning energy from gaseous matter, it is possible to construct weapons draining energy from enemy ships.

name: Starbase Construction
summary: A centralized space installation built in close orbit around the system primary is necessary to make full use of the resources in a star system.

name: Starport
summary: The earliest starbases were little more than makeshift outposts. Permanent starports will enable us to maintain a firmer grip on star systems.

name: Starhold
summary: As space traffic increases, larger and more defensible starbases are needed to maintain control over system spacelanes.

name: Star Fortress
summary: These mighty space forts will provide a focal point for all military activity in a star system, and their presence is sure to deter all but the most stubborn attackers.

name: Citadel
summary: Plans for an immense battlestation capable of holding its own against several strike fleets are now being drawn up. If realized, these citadels will become monuments to greatness as much as system hubs.

name: Starfire Cannon
summary: Like any potential hazard, the dangerous radiation from our star's transformation can also be harnessed as a useful tool. Channeling it as a beam weapon would allow us to overheat and disable enemy ships.

name: Standardized Stinger Incubation
summary: These facilities grow sleek, agile biological ships designed for precision and speed. Employing advanced biopods and specialized nutrient solutions, they produce vessels capable of precise and efficient strikes.

name: Improved Stinger Development
summary: Refined facilities accelerate growth cycles and improve bio-engineered precision, resulting in vessels with superior maneuverability and accuracy.

name: Advanced Stinger Development
summary: The apex of bioship growth technology, these advanced facilities produce Stingers of unmatched speed and lethality.

name: Stingers
summary: Stingers are designed to deliver devastating strikes against high-value targets. They excel in exploiting weaknesses in enemy defenses.

name: Storm Manipulation
summary: By harnessing the principles behind storm negation technologies, we can begin to manipulate the astrometeorological nature of the galaxy to serve our own needs.

name: Cosmic Weather Models
summary: Through the use of scientific weather models, we can track the movement and formation of impending Cosmic Storms.

name: Probability Current
summary: By applying probability currents to our scientific weather models, our ability to track the movement and formation of impending Cosmic Storms is greatly increased.

name: Strategic Coordination Center
summary: A facility synchronizing the national Starbase network, augmenting defensive and offensive capabilities.

name: Carrier Operations
summary: These manned strike craft are launched from a mothership and rely on their speed and small size to survive long enough to punch through enemy defenses.

name: Improved Strike Craft
summary: The next generation of strike craft, featuring improved avionics, better handling characteristics and more powerful armaments.

name: Advanced Strike Craft
summary: A further refinement in strike craft design, these advanced strike craft are a pilot's dream. Their performance far exceeds that of previous models.

name: Skravird Strike Craft
summary: Learning from the design expertise of Skrand and his people, these superior strike craft are capable of prolonged engagement and highly adaptive tactics.

name: Subdermal Stimulation
summary: Deep-tissue implants are the latest innovation in the revolutionary overlapping of sensory engineering and entertainment experiences. "Where we're going, we won't need skin to feel!"
