name: Subspace Drive
summary: An insight borne of a desperate desire to leave our home, these Subspace Drive engines were designed to facilitate limited interstellar travel.

name: Supreme Alloy
summary: What we thought was the greatest alloy turned out to be far from the truth. Countless pre-FTL refining processes have been cataloged, and we have now synthesized an unbeatable metal.

name: Swarm Spawning Pools
summary: Collecting specimens from defeated Prethoryn enables us to clone and genetically program a war-brood of our own.

name: Swarmer Missiles
summary: These smaller missiles are launched in volleys and have been specifically designed to overwhelm enemy point-defense systems.

name: Whirlwind Missiles
summary: New miniaturization techniques will allow us to equip swarmer missiles with more powerful warheads and improved flight performance.

name: Synchronized Defenses
summary: Aligning defensive and offensive weapon execution paradigms allows for increased efficiency.

name: Cetana's Thought
summary: This compendium, a gift from Cetana, is a tapestry of profound insights, elegantly composed and dense with meaning.

name: Artificial Personality Matrix
summary: Equipped with a personality, synthetics will finally be able to interact socially on equal terms with the rest of our citizens. Some units may even assume leadership roles.

name: Synthetic Thought Patterns
summary: Thinking outside the box merely places you in another, somewhat larger box.

name: Artificial Administration
summary: Highly advanced units that are stronger, faster and more durable than the vast majority of organics. With their upgraded neural processors they are fully capable of independent operations.

name: Telepathy
summary: Once fully adapted to the basics of Psionics, the mind is capable of connecting to other individuals, becoming something greater.

fields.potential: OR = { has_shroud_dlc = yes NOT = { has_ethic = ethic_gestalt_consciousness } }

name: Temple of Transportation
summary: Transportation networks bring people together: a sentiment shared by many civilization we observed. While we do not have steam engines, our hyper relay networks could serve a similar purpose.

name: Terrestrial Sculpting
summary: There is no simple solution to the problem of macro-scale reshaping of planetary crusts - only bigger trowels and orbitally-deployed drills.

name: Thought Enforcement
summary: Telepaths can monitor the citizenry for incorrect thoughts, but with some study they could also correct thought aberrations that they find.

fields.potential: OR = { has_shroud_dlc = yes NOT = { has_ethic = ethic_gestalt_consciousness } }

name: Chemical Thrusters
summary: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to function.

name: Ion Thrusters
summary: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.

name: Plasma Thrusters
summary: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.

name: Impulse Thrusters
summary: These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.

name: Thruster Bio-integration
summary: Artificial thrusters can be integrated into spaceborne organisms with appropriate considerations for energy supply and connections to neural motor centers.

name: Improved Titan Hulls
summary: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable titans.

name: Advanced Titan Hulls
summary: The latest generation of titan hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.

name: Titans
summary: Designing ships at this scale allows for a deadly combination of exceptional firepower and cutting-edge auxiliary support.

name: Tomb World Adaptation
summary: Through comprehensive study of irradiated environments we will allow our settlers to colonize worlds that have been devastated by nuclear warfare.

name: Space Torpedoes
summary: These torpedoes are essentially very large, slow-moving missiles. They are equipped with more powerful warheads and shield modulators that let them slip unmolested through energy screens.

fields.potential: OR = { country_uses_bio_ships = no has_tradition = tr_nanotech_4 has_crisis_level = crisis_level_2 has_technology = tech_cosmogenesis_escort }

name: Armored Torpedoes
summary: Upgraded space torpedoes encased in armor, to better withstand enemy point-defense fire. The armor fragments into shards that cause additional damage when the torpedo detonates.

name: Devastator Torpedoes
summary: Advanced torpedoes with very powerful warheads. They have a sleeker design, faster engines and upgraded shield modulators for slipping through energy screens.

name: Ocean Ecology Management
summary: Given enough processing power, networked sensors and distributed stations, even the ocean currents can be managed to a fine level of control.

name: Tracking Implants
summary: Further advancements in the field of subdermal implants can provide detailed information regarding the movements and actions of the implanted.

name: Metacognitive Faith
summary: Leaving our planetary cradle has opened us up to a new understanding of faith, and its place in a wider context.

fields.potential: OR = { is_spiritualist = yes AND = { is_gestalt = no has_make_spiritualist_perk = yes } }

name: Trinary Computing
summary: Different societies have developed alternative solutions for their logistics and computing. These alien ways of thinking have made it easier for us to adapt to foreign empires' structures.

name: Fissile Cores
summary: Redundant thought centers allow for a Crystalline Entity to split itself in two as a final gambit to protect its clutch against a particularly dangerous foe.

name: Gastric Fountain
summary: The powerful digestive system of a Cutholoid can be repurposed to fire kinetic projectiles at extremely high velocity.

name: Restorative Enzymes
summary: On death, the Tiyanki Matriarch produces an assortment of protective chemicals in a final attempt to preserve the lives of her remaining kin.

name: Leechcraft
summary: Modified Flagella spawn that siphon nutrients and materials from their prey in order to support the regeneration of their host Amoeba.

name: Starborne Biology
summary: A main source of energy for large creatures in deep space comes from the power of starlight. The closer they are to brighter stars, the faster they develop.

name: Herdsong Chords
summary: The somber song of the Tiyanki inspires its fellow creatures, hardening their resolve in combat.

name: Virulent Cysts
summary: Cysts filled with reproductive fluid allow for each Voidworm in a fertile Troika to independently produce spawn when bombarding an inhabited planet.

name: Unity of Purpose
summary: The purpose of one is the purpose of all. Together, we are greater than the sum of our parts.

name: Universal Macrophage
summary: These powerful immunology boosters make disease a thing of the past, allowing organic populations to live fuller, healthier lives. May cause serious side effects.

name: Unusual Senses
summary: Nothing is more innovative than natural evolution. By studying how pre-FTL societies view their world, we have devised new methods of detecting uninvited ships.

name: Vitality Boosters
summary: Where the body fails, science intervenes.

name: Voidworm Immunity
summary: We can develop a cure for Voidworm parasitic infection. All of our colonies would be rendered immune to their current strain of spore bombardment.

name: Volatile Material Plants
summary: Aside from the obvious safety concerns, the artificial creation of Volatile Motes is an extremely delicate and complicated process that requires highly specialized equipment.

name: Volcanic Forge
summary: When deployed, this facility slowly transforms a planet into a volcanic paradise, surfacing useful resources along the way. Thermoforgers can accelerate the transformation.

name: Volcanic Terraforming
summary: Advances in material technology and deep-shaft mining techniques allow geo-engineering at previously unthinkable depths and temperatures. We can terraform a Volcanic World into a temperate planet.

name: Deep Crust Engineering
summary: Advances in material technology and deep-shaft mining techniques allow geo-engineering at previously unthinkable depths and temperatures. Magma hotspots can now be exploited, suppressed, or even relocated.

name: Waystations
summary: Waystations collect celestial resources and form interstellar trade routes.

name: Improved Wayline Logistics
summary: Our Waystations are no longer simple markers along the stars. Improved logistics allow them to store greater reserves and transfer resources more efficiently along established Waylines.

name: Advanced Wayline Logistics
summary: Advanced coordination protocols bind distant Waystations into a cohesive network. Resources, signals, and supplies move across the Waylines with unmatched precision.

name: Vector Lock Cannon
summary: Biologically enhanced projectiles are fired, countering evasive maneuvers and striking agile targets.

name: Enzymatic Webcaster
summary: Fires refined projectiles with superior tracking enzymes and adaptive flight paths, increasing hit rates against fast-moving targets.

name: Seeker Shard Array
summary: Deploys self-guided bio-munitions that lock onto movement patterns, ensuring accuracy against elusive enemies.

name: Pinion Accelerator
summary: Utilizes complex organic targeting systems that anticipate evasive actions, making even the most agile prey vulnerable.

name: Prey Tracker
summary: Fires intelligent bio-projectiles equipped with predictive tracking, overcoming the most sophisticated evasion protocols.

name: Precision Lancer
summary: Deploys bio-plasma rounds that adapt mid-flight, guaranteeing hits against even the most erratic maneuvers.

name: Reload Jammer
summary: Launches organic projectiles that release specialized enzymes, interfering with enemy weapon reloading systems and reducing their rate of fire.

name: Fire Disrupter
summary: Enhances disruption enzymes to interfere more effectively with reloading cycles, significantly delaying enemy volleys.

name: Mind Missiles
summary: Deploys intelligent bio-projectiles that target critical reloading systems, creating cascading delays across enemy fleets.

name: Degradation Beams
summary: Utilizes adaptive biological compounds that degrade reloading mechanisms, halving the firing efficiency of even the most advanced weaponry.

name: Fiend Disabler
summary: Fires advanced munitions that emit suppression fields, crippling enemy reloading systems and rendering them painfully slow.

name: Tracker Stopper
summary: Releases a biological pulse that locks down enemy reloading for extended periods.

name: Gloom Spores
summary: Organic projectiles imbued with destabilizing enzymes scramble enemy targeting systems and reduce their accuracy.

name: Tangle Pulse
summary: Refined biological compounds disrupt targeting systems and short-range communications, sowing chaos among enemy ranks.

name: Neuro Scourge
summary: Adaptive bio-munitions are deployed to exploit neural weaknesses in both organic and synthetic crews, crippling enemy efficiency.

name: Ruin Barbs
summary: Intelligent bio-projectiles emit disruptive fields on impact, scrambling enemy targeting systems and causing widespread malfunctions.

name: Snare Darts
summary: Advanced biological ordnance creates a cascading feedback loop within enemy systems, rendering their attacks wildly ineffective.

name: Havoc Storm
summary: Bio-electromagnetic pulses incapacitate targeting systems and leave fleets in a state of disarray.

name: Energy Burster
summary: Fires bio-projectiles that emit bursts of energy upon impact, subtly enhancing the maneuverability of our vessels.

name: Tangler Pod Launcher
summary: Releases concentrated bio-energetic fields, further boosting the evasion capabilities of our ships.

name: Agile Spike Array
summary: Launches intelligent bio-projectiles that adaptively enhance agility, ensuring superior evasion even in the most chaotic battles.

name: Electro Sprayer
summary: Deploys advanced munitions that generate dynamic bio-electric auras, significantly improving the ability of ships to evade enemy fire.

name: Evasion Darts
summary: Fires highly advanced projectiles that create large-scale enhancement fields, granting unparalleled evasion to fleets.

name: Adaptive Tendrils
summary: Fires bio-munitions that emit fields of adaptive energy, allowing fleets to dance effortlessly out of harm's way.

name: Weaver Biofield Generators
summary: Fires organic projectiles that emit energizing biofields, subtly increasing the firing speed of weapons systems.

name: Weaver Booster Blaster
summary: Refined bio-munitions enhance biofield intensity, further accelerating the rate of fire.

name: Weaver Organo-Tech Amplifier
summary: Deploys adaptive bio-projectiles that amplify reaction times and system efficiency, enabling a significant increase in fire rate.

name: Weaver Aura Caster
summary: Generates dynamic bio-electric auras, vastly enhancing firing speed across multiple vessels, ensuring relentless pressure on enemy fleets.

name: Weaver Swift Shooter
summary: Unleashes hyper-charged bio-munitions that create large-scale enhancement fields, enabling fleets to unleash sustained, rapid-fire barrages.

name: Weaver Wave Maker
summary: Projects waves of bio-energy that push our weaponry to their peak performance, flooding the battlefield with devastating firepower.

name: Spore Launcher
summary: Regenerative pods are launched to deliver strong healing compounds to allied ships.

name: Improved Spore Launcher
summary: Highly efficient pods imbued with healing biomatter are deployed to rapidly repair damage across multiple vessels.

name: Advanced Spore Launcher
summary: Pods containing repair agents are launched, optimizing healing based on the severity of damage and ensuring no vulnerabilities remain.

name: Adaptive Spore Launcher
summary: Pods that saturate the battlefield with adaptive spores provide smart healing to all allied vessels within range.

name: Intelligent Adaptive Spore Launcher
summary: Deploys pods that unleash a wave of intelligent microorganisms, capable of revitalizing even the most damaged fleets.

name: Rebirth Spores
summary: Pods filled with malleable cells are launched to trigger the growth of new hull tissues, pushing the endurance of organic vessels beyond their former limits.

name: Standardized Weaver Incubation
summary: These facilities nurture mid-sized biological ships within refined biopods, employing enhanced nutrient delivery and genetic optimization to produce agile and adaptable vessels for the fleet.

name: Improved Weaver Development
summary: These facilities employ enhanced bio-engineering techniques to accelerate growth cycles and enhance vessel adaptability.

name: Advanced Weaver Development
summary: These facilities produce biological ships of unparalleled precision and versatility.

name: Weavers
summary: Building on the foundations of early bio-engineering, Weavers are crafted to balance agility with increased combat capabilities.

name: Clustered Synapses
summary: We can accelerate the fluency of global, collective thought by investing it in gatherings of symbionts whose sole purpose in life is to facilitate that same will.

name: Confluence of Thought
summary: Our mutualistic will shall be strengthened by vast gatherings of deeply empathic symbionts, so in-tune with their surroundings as to concentrate and re-broadcast our collective thought.

name: Centers of Being
summary: By encouraging the growth of deep-thinking symbionts in glades throughout our distributed self, our collective will shall be felt more keenly by all.

name: Planetary Germination
summary: To spread our roots to a new world first requires us to prepare the seedbed. By first terraforming a planet we can ensure that our colonies are off to a healthy start.

name: Wormhole Stabilization
summary: A naturally occurring subspace wormhole is a fickle thing, and its fluctuating energy levels typically make it impossible to travel safely between its linked apertures.

name: Xeno-Aesthetics
summary: After analyzing a multitude of artists from drastically different cultures, we have come up with a general theorem. By studying a civilization's art and culture, we can gain an advantage against them in combat.

name: Xeno Diplomacy
summary: Advancing our understanding of interactions with - and manipulations of - the xeno is a necessary step in forming more permanent interstellar alliances.

name: Xeno-Linguistics
summary: Given recent encounters with intelligent races, it is essential that we improve our xeno-linguistic capabilities.

fields.potential: has_paragon_dlc = yes is_regular_empire = yes is_gestalt = no is_homicidal = no

name: Xeno Relations
summary: The complexities of interstellar diplomacy necessitate the forming of bonds with foreign powers in order to further one's goals.

name: Xeno Outreach Agencies
summary: This corporate agency promotes a wide variety of interstellar tourist attractions, as well as offering employment packages and signing bonuses to potential emigrants interested in relocating to corporate space.

name: Zero Point Power
summary: These generators extract vacuum energy, providing an almost limitless supply of ship power. There is no more efficient way to generate energy.

name: Zro Launchers
summary: These highly concentrated pellets of zro can be dispersed through enemy shields unabated, shifting through multiple realities. Once contact is made with a physical object, the effects are exponential in devastation.
